preprocess.format: "data_type=sft": outputs SFT data; medical Raw data also needs a strategy. Replace the example path with your data directory.

training.task: "Run": tells the system to start a training task.
training.mode: "LoRA batch training": uses LoRA training so first-time users can run through the flow quickly.

monitor.task: "Monitor training": checks the backend training process and latest status.
monitor.container: "Container training_container": tells the system which container to read training status from.

instruction.title: Operation Instructions
instruction.step1: Click "Generate Command and Place in Input". The system will first check for a runnable instance.
instruction.step2: If a runnable instance is available, the command will be placed in the chat input and the wizard will temporarily collapse.
instruction.step3: Click the blue send button (▶) in the lower right to execute the command.
instruction.step4: After sending, the system waits for execution to finish and then prompts you to continue.

instruction.title: Operation Instructions
instruction.step1: Click "Generate Command and Place in Input". The system will first check for a runnable instance.
instruction.step2: If a runnable instance is available, the training command will be placed in the chat input and the wizard will temporarily collapse.
instruction.step3: Click the blue send button (▶) in the lower right to start training.

step4.title: Step 4: Monitor Training Progress
step4.subtitle: After the training task status bar appears, use Query Status, Open Monitor Panel, and Stop Training there to manage training monitoring.

step1.label: Step 1
step1.title: Query Training Status
step1.desc: Click Query Status in the training task status bar to query the current training process and monitor status.

step2.label: Step 2
step2.title: Open Monitor Panel
step2.desc: Click Open Monitor Panel in the training task status bar to view Loss curves, learning rate, and other training metrics.

step3.label: Step 3
step3.title: Stop Training
step3.desc: When you need to end the task, click Stop Training in the training task status bar to stop the current training run.

instruction.title: Operation Instructions
instruction.step1: Click "Generate Command and Place in Input". The system will first check for a runnable instance.
instruction.step2: If a runnable instance is available, the monitor command will be placed in the chat input and the wizard will temporarily collapse.
instruction.step3: Click the blue send button (▶) in the lower right to view training status.
instruction.step4: After the execution result returns, the wizard completes automatically. You can later open the monitor panel from the training task status bar to inspect the Loss curve.
